title: A Carleman contraction method for inverse initial data recovery in the Navier-Stokes equations with unknown body force
summary: We solve an inverse initial data problem for the incompressible Navier-Stokes system. The objective is to recover the initial velocity and pressure from lateral boundary observations, without assuming that the time-independent body force is known. To eliminate this unknown force, we differentiate the momentum equation with respect to time and then apply a Legendre polynomial-exponential time-dimensional reduction.
